findings.claim: The new native-hook receipt settlement path has no regression test proving that settling one binding's seat-level receipt preserves a sibling binding's unread delivery and wake eligibility.
findings.evidence: LazyCommit::submit now settles receipt_candidates through CompleteInboxDelivery before advancing the displaying binding's cursors. This changes seat-level receipt attention while presentation remains binding-specific. Design section 5 explicitly requires a sibling to retain its own unread stream and independent delivery-row wake after another binding settles the receipt. The new native process regressions at tests/hook_entrypoint.rs:2644 and :7617 create only one recipient binding. Existing tests/hook_entrypoint.rs:2279 exercises two bindings with a default lazy pair opener and text accept, without any requested receipt; tests/store/receipts.rs:5324 tests two AckDisplayed calls and first-settler attribution but does not invoke native hooks or assert sibling delivery/wake. tests/integration/lazy_attention.rs:1222 covers sibling invitation service, without native receipt completion. These tests would still pass if native automatic settlement suppressed a sibling's independent ordinary-message delivery or wake.

findings.claim: The normative trust policy still describes delivery auto-ACK as a mod-only exception and documents the removed body-plus-ack truncation recipe.
findings.evidence: The decision paragraph says delivery auto-ACK is forbidden except for the bundled Claude mod, then says its truncation marker names body followed by ack (lines 1702–1706). This PR authorizes standard native-hook receipt completion and changes src/protocol/watch.rs::truncation_marker_for to emit only an inbox continuation. The design section 4 explicitly requires updating the old mod-only exception wording, but this paragraph retains both superseded statements without an amendment or historical qualification.

findings.claim: The public completion-command documentation still promises that CompleteInboxDelivery never ACKs, although its new receipt_candidates field now authorizes receipt settlement.
findings.evidence: Both Command::CompleteInboxDelivery and SemanticMutation::CompleteInboxDelivery retain the documentation 'Presentation bookkeeping only; never an ACK or adoption.' The same file now introduces receipt_candidates requiring hook.context_receipts_v1 and via=hook_context (lines 948–951), and the changed store handler calls complete_hook_context to settle those receipts. These are public protocol/API comments about the operation's authority boundary, and they now contradict its implemented side effects.
